verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page says users can manage Jira issues inside Bitbucket through a built-in Jira UI, open Jira tickets directly from the PR screen, and have issue statuses update automatically when issue keys appear in commits. That covers viewing and managing external tracker tickets in the code host and opening them from pull requests. The evidence is only short marketing claims, and the integration is documented only for Atlassian's own Jira. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the scope of ticket management in the embedded Jira UI, independent or hands-on corroboration, evidence of support for non-Jira trackers.
